## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Both extended policies of this task are lossless at the level of entailment, with every factor ladder carried in full in its own document, and so are the base domain and the retired surface. First revision.

Coverage note: four inputs of the denied-operation price are product figures of ADAS Sensor Calibrations: the tier's calibration price, whether it requires an alignment, the alignment check and correction fees, and the standalone diagnostic fee. The claim corpus names each one correctly by product, tier and figure name, which is the claim side's whole obligation. That product's corpus is not on disk at audit time. Whether it states those figures is outside this skill's detection range (cross-product). Task 1's runtime solvability depends on it.

Policy-side notes: the same two as task 0 (the storage eligibility sentence retired with an unrelated `replaced_by`; the Express entry gate's "drivable at drop-off" vs. the class-assignment rule's "drivable at the estimate").
